build: SwiftBuild Release -O; no sanitizers, tracing or coverage
controls: distance1;gaborish/adaptiveQF/DCsmoothing true;fivewarmups per mode;20timed iterations per mode, cyclic interleave. Parent and sibling agents confirmed build/test/probe processes quiet.
limits: Single synthetic64x64RGBA8 case is a local hot-path measurement, not broad speedup or release-performance qualification.
Hardware model and combined peakRSS unavailable because sandbox blocked sysctl. Probe completed60timed rows; outer /usr/bin/time -l exited1 only on kern.clockrate read after probe completed.
Pixel/workspace allocation peaks, copy bytes and allocation count not instrumented; cumulative conservative admission is reported separately and is not peakmemory.
